name: Extract Source Time Series
summary: Extracts mean source time courses for selected labels of a FreeSurfer atlas from an MEG/EEG source estimate with MNE-Python, and outputs a timeseries table, surface GIfTI time courses and a report.
description: Reads the left and right hemisphere STC files, loads the requested atlas labels with mne.read_labels_from_annot, averages the source amplitude within each label at every time point, paints the label time courses back onto the surface vertices, and renders plots into an HTML report. Use it to get ROI time series from source-localised MEG/EEG. Needs the subject's FreeSurfer directory with the atlas annotation and a FreeSurfer license.

inputs.description: Source estimate (left and right hemisphere .stc files).
FreeSurfer subject directory providing the atlas annotation labels.

outputs.description: HTML report with time course plots and brain renders of the labels.

parameters.description: comma separated label names to extract

citations.text: Gramfort A, et al. MEG and EEG data analysis with MNE-Python. Front Neurosci 7(267):1-13 (2013).
